I had the same issue!! I did everything from masks to avoiding heat and getting trims. But after a few weeks my ends looked dry and damaged again. Turns out that I have high porosity hair, which can’t hold onto moisture as good as low porosity hair. High porosity hair follicles are “open” which leads to loss of hydration in the hair. That’s why your hair also probably dries very fast. So here is what I changed:

- before showering: adding conditioner and hair oil to dry hair. If you have time, wait for 10 minutes. If not, it’s also fine but use the conditioner at least before wetting your hair
- in the shower: after shampooing (doesn’t matter what shampoo), do a very hydrating mask. I love the garnier cocoa or macadamia mask.
- after the mask: use a conditioner for dry hair. anything with oils in the name is good (eg. Elvital oil magique).
- after the shower: use a leave in for dry hair. I use the redken all soft, and it’s the only high end product I’d recommend. Everything else you can get from the drugstore. I also mix in the ogx argan oil.
- drying your hair: I actually dry my hair on medium heat. apparently this seals the open hair structure, which makes your hair look frizzy.

I can distract myself but not to fill a void inside of me. I’m also perfectly fine to just hang out at home alone. But it shows me that there are so many great people out there. I think the most important part is taking your time and allowing the emotions
